affected_party: operators, service owners, and stakeholders exposed to coordinated intervention failures
actual_problem: individually valid interventions can conflict, propagate across dependencies, saturate shared resources, or exceed intended blast radius when multiple agents, services, or operational lanes act together
why_it_matters: local recovery can still create systemic failure, unauthorized cross-lane action, or hidden downstream loss
why_now: current multi-agent evidence shows correlated behavior, conflicting objectives, resource flooding, and fast escalation that single-lane controls do not capture
